description: Find a person's Western zodiac (sun) sign from their birth date, with the same date ranges as Anahana's free Zodiac Sign Calculator. Returns the sign, symbol, its date range, the sign's page and the calculator page in the language asked for, and, where Anahana sells one in that language, the natal chart report's product page (moon and rising signs need birth time and place). Read-only; no payment link; the birth date is not stored.

birth_date.description: The birth date as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "1990-07-04".

language.description: Language for the linked pages, e.g. "de". One code; defaults to "en".

name: get_zodiac_sign
title: Find a zodiac (sun) sign from a birth date
